crossRefs.note: Who is there among you who will give ear to this? Who will listen and hear for the time to come?
“Remember this, and show yourselves men. Bring it to mind again, you transgressors.
Remember the former things of old: for I am God, and there is no other. I am God, and there is none like me.
Only be careful, and keep your soul diligently, lest you forget the things which your eyes saw, and lest they depart…
Be careful, lest you forget the covenant of Yahweh your God, which he made with you, and make yourselves a carved image…
“Now therefore write this song for yourselves, and teach it to the children of Israel. Put it in their mouths, that…
Of the Rock who became your father, you are unmindful, and have forgotten God who gave you birth.
Yet listen now, Jacob my servant, and Israel, whom I have chosen.
This is what Yahweh who made you, and formed you from the womb, who will help you says: “Don’t be afraid, Jacob my…
“But you, Israel, my servant, Jacob whom I have chosen, the offspring of Abraham my friend,
You whom I have taken hold of from the ends of the earth, and called from its corners, and said to you, ‘You are my…
But now Yahweh who created you, Jacob, and he who formed you, Israel, says: “Don’t be afraid, for I have redeemed you.…
everyone who is called by my name, and whom I have created for my glory, whom I have formed, yes, whom I have made.’ ”
I am Yahweh, your Holy One, the Creator of Israel, your King.”
“Can a woman forget her nursing child, that she should not have compassion on the son of her womb? Yes, these may…
Behold, I have engraved you on the palms of my hands. Your walls are continually before me.
Concerning the Good News, they are enemies for your sake. But concerning the election, they are beloved for the…
For the gifts and the calling of God are irrevocable.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: Remember these things, Jacob and Israel; for you are my servant. I have formed you. You are my servant. Israel, you will not be forgotten by me.
translations.bsb: Remember these things, O Jacob, for you are My servant, O Israel. I have made you, and you are My servant; O Israel, I will never forget you.
translations.kjv: Remember these, O Jacob and Israel; for thou art my servant: I have formed thee; thou art my servant: O Israel, thou shalt not be forgotten
translations.asv: Remember these things, O Jacob, and Israel; for thou art my servant: I have formed thee; thou art my servant: O Israel, thou shalt not be forgotten of me.
